messages:
jordan-cust: Hey team — since last Friday we've seen our structured JSON responses start failing schema validation. The model returns: \"\" for booleans and sometimes null instead of false. This broke a downstream billing job (retries spiked). stack: prod-us-west, api v1.3.2, using strict_json mode.

anya-support: Sorry about the break, Jordan. Can you paste a failing example payload and the schema you sent? Also which model & settings (streaming, max_tokens, strict_json options)?

jordan-cust: Example request body: ```json
{"input":"summarize invoice","schema":{"amount":"number","paid":"boolean","status":"enum:[PAID,UNPAID]"}}
``` Model returned: ```json
{"amount":"12345","paid":"","status":"paid"}
``` Note: paid is empty string, status is lowercase. We do strict schema validation downstream and it rejects. We enabled strict_json=true last week.

anya-support: Got it. Quick questions: did you enable streaming=true? And do you have coerce_types or preserve_nulls flags set?

jordan-cust: streaming=false, strict_json=true, we didn't set coerce_types (default). preserve_nulls=false.

alex-eng: FYI — we just rolled a parser tweak in runtime two days ago that tightened numeric inference in strict_json. There's a known edge where empty tokens can come through as empty-string when KV cache prefixing + chunk boundary hits exactly between a token and the boolean value. Repro steps coming.

priya-devex: @jordan-cust can you try switching strict_json=false as a quick unblock? If that fixes it, we can scope a hotfix. Also try adding coerce_types=false to force strict type errors rather than coercion.

jordan-cust: Turning strict_json off makes our app accept the payload (we can coerce locally), but we lose the safety we wanted. coerce_types=false made the request fail earlier with a 400 and returned a parse error from the API: \"invalid_json: field \"paid\" expected boolean got string\" — so that would have prevented downstream retries. But we need a long-term fix so we can keep strict_json on.

anya-support: Thanks — that's useful. Alex, can you reproduce locally with the same model and scale? Any quick mitigations?

alex-eng: Repro steps I used: call model gpt-open-7b-quant with prompt that emits JSON chunked across two response frames. At chunk boundary the boolean token "true" gets split and the streaming assembly step collapses it to empty string in strict mode during postprocess. Minimal repro attached: ```bash
echo -n '{"paid": tru' > part1.json
echo 'e,"amount":123}' > part2.json
cat part1.json part2.json | ./assemble_stream.sh | jq .
``` Output shows paid = "" in assembled buffer when a race condition hits.

alex-eng: Root cause: parser's chunk-join logic treats missing token fragments as empty token when strict_json error recovery runs. It was intended to be tolerant but for booleans it becomes empty string.

anya-support: That explains Jordan's payload. Is there a patch we can ship quickly?

alex-eng: Yes — we can backport a hotfix that changes recovery: if strict_json==true and streaming==false we ensure parser waits for full token; if streaming==true we return a parse error instead of empty-string coercion. Should be a small runtime change; CC eng-oncall. ETA for prod rollout ~ 6 hours if approved.

priya-devex: Action: roll a patch to the runtime parser and mark as P2. Jordan, we'll coordinate a maintenance window or do a targeted rollout to prod-us-west first. If you'd rather we rollback the parser change from two days ago, we can also do that as a stopgap (less ideal).

jordan-cust: Targeted rollout sounds good. We also need an operational workaround: can we detect these cases and avoid causing billing retries? Our billing job treats schema validation errors as transient and retries. Any header or response code we can use to treat as permanent?

anya-support: For now, set coerce_types=false on your client so the API returns 400 error early (non-retryable). Also add a quick pre-validate step on your side to map lowercase enums to uppercase before validating, and treat empty-string for booleans as failure. We'll follow up with a server-side fix.

alex-eng: Patch PR: internal link to runtime PR #3128. I'll attach logs in that PR. Deploy plan: staged canary → region prod-us-west → global. Will add a safety flag to enable strict streaming behavior for a single customer if needed.

ticket-bot: Ticket #INC-2026 created for "strict_json boolean null-coercion causing billing retries" assigned to eng-runtime, priority P2.

anya-support: Follow-ups: 1) Jordan, please confirm you applied coerce_types=false and observed 400s instead of retries. 2) Alex to post PR link and ETA. 3) Priya will coordinate rollout window.

jordan-cust: Confirmed coerce_types=false yields immediate 400 and stops retries. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please ping when rollout is scheduled. :thumbsup:

alex-eng: PR posted and linked in ticket. Rolling canary in 30m to staging, can promote to prod-us-west in ~5h if no regressions.

anya-support: Closing loop: we'll update you in the ticket and send a postmortem once fixed. Thanks all. :pray:
